requirements.desc: When SDD flow procedure text describes implementation work involving prompt guidance moved between flow skill or flow prompt files, it shall require checking related shared regression tests for placement-contract assertions.
requirements.note: R1: requires checking related shared regression tests when prompt guidance moves

requirements.desc: The procedure text shall explicitly require both old-placement removal assertions and new-placement presence assertions for moved prompt guidance.
requirements.note: R2: requires both old-placement removal and new-placement presence assertions

requirements.desc: The procedure text shall apply to prompt guidance movement in general and shall not limit the rule to workflow board guidance only.
requirements.note: R3: applies to prompt guidance moves in general

requirements.desc: Spec-local tests shall verify the SDD flow skill source contains the prompt-guidance movement regression-test instruction and the two placement assertion requirements.
requirements.note: R4: verifies the SDD flow skill source contains the full instruction contract

requirements.desc: If the implementation changes `src/skills/`, generated agent skills shall be updated by running `sdd-forge upgrade`.
requirements.note: R5: verifies generated agent skill contains the same instruction contract
